sections.name: ExternalLink
sections.title: Link or unavailable label
sections.what: Shows a link that opens in a new tab, or a greyed Source link unavailable label when the address is empty.
sections.watch_out: The safe settings for new tabs must stay in place; removing them exposes the original page to the new one.

summary: A link button to a source page, or a greyed label that says the link is unavailable when no usable address exists.
purpose: Gives every source link the same look and behaviour.
why: Likely reason: avoids a dead or broken link when an address is missing.
how: Tidies the address. If it is empty, shows a disabled label. Otherwise shows a link that opens in a new tab with safe settings.
inputs: An address, a label (default Open Source), an optional class and a test id.
outputs: A link button or a disabled label.
risks: The link is only as good as the stored address. A wrong address still opens a wrong page.
debug: If the label says unavailable, check the stored address for this field.
